description: The routes whose request a check on the request reads (an organization's check that runs before the provider, or a rule in the gateway's config file at the pre stage), and what it reads on each (release notes C32 and C35). On every route listed in read, a request a check blocks is refused before the provider gets it; a check's rewrite (pii-detection's mask, redact or hash) reaches the provider or the request is refused (remediation_unavailable); and where unread names what the checks cannot read, a check that would block or rewrite the request refuses it before the provider (request_unavailable), whatever its text. A route with a note is served only as the note says. no_model_text lists the POST routes that send no text a model reads to a provider (or no request at all), and not_served the APIs this gateway has no route for: neither is read. Two tests read this file, so neither the console nor the gateway can drift from it unnoticed: the gateway's (agentcc-gateway/internal/server/guardrail_request_routes_contract_test.go) checks that every POST route the gateway registers under /v1, /v1beta and /a2a, and the batch API, is in read (by one of its patterns) or no_model_text, that each route in read is one its request-check tests send a request a check blocks to, and that no route in not_served is registered; the console's (frontend/src/sections/gateway/guardrails/requestRoutes.test.jsx) checks that the Guardrails page lists exactly these routes.
